verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a public API with quickstart, authentication (API keys), agent creation/management endpoints, and an API reference section, plus SDKs, CLI, and MCP server all built atop this API, showing it's a genuinely drivable, documented public interface. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404s) and no independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party docs.
